notes.title: Add Korean Ver. build & Japanese Ver. build to the existing English Ver. Build
notes.content:
- Users can use most of the functions of Korean keyboards and most of the Japanese keyboards.
- Within the app, each user can select the manual of the language he(or she) wants among the English manual, the Japanese Manual, and the Korean manual.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content: 1. Add the floor reflection feature. 2. Modify app manual. 3. Reduce line skipping

notes.title: Improving several features
notes.content:
1. Improve the vibration of Tablet's rolling during automatic tablet posture control.
2. Optimize the parameters related to keyboard's automatic moving & automatic size adjusting in order for user to type comfortably and accurately.
